hypotheses.title: Subindustry Consensus Book Value Surprise & Valuation Synergy (anl4_bvps_median, 252d)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines 252-day forward consensus book-to-price valuation with 252-day forward consensus book innovation momentum (anl4_bvps_median - ts_mean(anl4_bvps_median, 252)), neutralized within granular subindustries. Standalone book yield demonstrated 0.00 self-correlation, Sharpe 1.32, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.25, and Fitness 0.96 in Batch 167 Candidate 3 (just 0.04 below platform approval). Neutralizing at the subindustry level and extending valuation horizon to 252 days eliminates intra-industry accounting heterogeneity, boosts cross-sectional rank dispersion, and drives Fitness >= 1.20 with zero self-correlation.
confounders: Unforeseen asset impairments not yet recognized in analyst book estimates
Disruptive technology shifts eroding historical tangible asset values
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms if consensus book value upward revisions fail to predict fundamental equity growth within subindustries.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_bvps_median, 60) / close, 252), subindustry) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_bvps_median, 60) - ts_mean(ts_backfill(anl4_bvps_median, 60), 252), 252), subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutral consensus book-to-price with 1-year book forecast innovation surprise rank and 5-day reversal overlay

hypotheses.title: Subindustry Domestic Operating EBIT Revision Momentum (fnd2_ebitdm, 252d)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Harnesses domestic operating EBIT yield (fnd2_ebitdm / close) and 60-day operational yield revision momentum, neutralized at the granular subindustry level. In Batch 166 Candidate 1, domestic EBIT yield revision demonstrated 0.00 self-correlation, Sharpe 1.34, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.66, and Turnover 14.11%. Subindustry neutralization removes macro sector cyclicality, isolating pure peer-relative operational compounding and boosting risk-adjusted returns to target Fitness >= 1.20 with zero self-correlation.
confounders: Domestic economic recessions disproportionately affecting domestically focused firms
Cost-push inflation squeezing domestic margins faster than multinational exporters
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha breaks down if domestic earnings innovations fail to generate post-earnings price drift over subsequent 20-day holding windows within subindustries.

candidates.expression: 0.70 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(fnd2_ebitdm, 60) / close, 252), subindustry) - 0.5, 2) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_delta(ts_backfill(fnd2_ebitdm, 60) / close, 60), subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutral domestic operating EBIT yield with 60-day yield revision delta and 5-day reversal overlay

hypotheses.title: 180-Day Realized Low-Volatility Anomaly (historical_volatility_180) (option8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures the classic Low-Volatility / Low-Beta Anomaly (Baker, Bradley, & Wurgler 2011; Finding Alphas, Tulchinsky) using 180-day option-market realized volatility (historical_volatility_180 from option8). Institutional benchmarking constraints and lottery-seeking retail behavior systematically overprice volatile equities, creating durable excess risk-adjusted returns for boring, ultra-low volatility stocks. Realized volatility exhibits high persistence (autocorrelation > 0.95), generating ultra-low turnover (< 10%) and zero self-correlation against all fundamental valuation alphas.
confounders: Sudden volatility regime shocks during acute market liquidity panics
Interest rate spikes disproportionately hurting bond-proxy defensive equities
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if high-volatility equities consistently outperform low-volatility equities on a risk-adjusted basis over multi-month horizons.

candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral 180-day realized low-volatility tilt with signed power tail amplification and 3-day short-term reversal overlay
